coverage: Complete object-ID inventories of City outdoor recreation and sports-field layers, classified using published sport fields; plus all five indoor pools and six arenas in the City facility directories reviewed 2026-09-28. All eight City outdoor pools are represented: Holly is supplied by the recreation-amenities source because it is absent from the outdoor-recreation polygon layer. Not every private, school or regional sports facility.

classification: Primary-use field determines soccer/baseball. Softball is included under Baseball field. Other/unknown grass or synthetic fields remain Sports field. Shared basketball/hockey courts appear once under Basketball court with a service note; outdoor hockey never becomes an ice arena.
status: Permanent/inactive/proposed and private records are excluded. Temporary maintenance at Guildford is retained with its dated closure note. Outdoor pools are seasonal. Source OPERATING is inventory status, not live opening hours or unrestricted access.
geometry: Original geometries and attributes retained in city-sports.raw.json. Search points use source point or polygon bounding-box centre, with SOURCE_BBOX retained; they are not entrance coordinates.
validation: Source count equals unique ID inventory; every requested batch returned exactly its requested IDs; indoor facility allowlist matches current directories; all selected objects retain their source identity.
